name: Svarnim Trade Udyog Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Svarnim Trade 
Udyog Ltd trades Textile products 
and deals in financing activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
STUL is engaged in trading, import /export, and supply of diverse commodities including:
a) Agricultural & raw goods: 
Cotton, jute, tea, coffee, rubber, grains, pulses, seeds
b) Textiles & materials: 
Garments, yarn, synthetic and fibrous goods
c) Industrial & Consumers: 
Chemicals, fertilizers, coal, engineering goods, building materials
d) Home & office items: **
Appliances, furniture, utensils, decorative and gift items
e) Electrical & electronics: 
This includes chandeliers, lamp shades, and related articles
f) Others:**
It also operates as dealer, supplier, contractor, agent, broker, and commission agent across all listed categories.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
